description: When the person says "Open my coach" (or advisor, counselor, teacher, mentor): returns the call to open_coach that opens the coach (a coach view in this chat) for this same interview, with the interview's context and the earlier coaching context so the same coach reopens, and where the interview continues. Its answer carries the AI oath (oath): say it first, every time the coach opens, before any question, ask the person whether they agree, and send their answer back as oath_answer; their yes is their consent for the coach to keep their record (sessions and milestones, never the words) beyond this visit. Nothing is open until open_coach answers: then call open_my_coach again with avatar_status and what open_coach actually returned (coach.coach_id, coach.seat, coach.page_url), and the size preset and display mode the view reports, so the package records them. Opening, resizing or closing the coach never resets the interview.

age_band.description: Sent with oath_answer: whether the person said they are under 18, or 18 and over. 18 and over: their yes keeps the record. Under 18: the record is kept only when their sponsor agreed at purchase as well as their own yes. Not given: the record is kept only for this visit

avatar_conversation.description: The coach.coach_id open_coach returned (the avatar service's conversation)

avatar_replaced.description: When open_coach answered status replaced: the coach.replaced.previous_coach_id it replaced, so the package records which coaching context the new one took over from

avatar_status.description: What open_coach actually answered; opened needs avatar_conversation

display_mode.description: The display mode the coach view reports the host granted

handle_token.description: Optional: the signed handle token from the person's own KSAWorks link, so the coach keeps a session record (facts only, never the words) and can say where they left off

invitation_code.description: Optional: the code from the person's sponsored invitation link, so the session is counted under that sponsorship. A learner with no handle yet gets one made at this first session from the redeemed invitation

oath_answer.description: The person's answer at the oath, after you said it to them: yes keeps their record (facts only, never the words) from then on; no keeps it only for this visit

package.description: The package the last Selfie answer returned (goldribbon_package_v1 with its selfie_interview part). Keep it for the person and send it back whole; no copy is kept.

size_preset.description: The person's size choice, as the coach view reports it

name: open_my_coach

coach_call.description: The open_coach call to make: tool and arguments

last_session.description: The person's previous session: its start, end and where to continue

limits.description: What this answer could not do, each { code, statement }

oath.description: The AI oath: when to say it (first, every time the coach opens), its promises, what to ask, and what to send back as oath_answer

package.description: The person's package with the interview; absent when the call could not use it

problem.description: When status is needs_attention: code, statement, what_to_do

session.description: The session record this call started, changed or ended (facts only)

status.description: What happened, or needs_attention with a problem

title: Open My Coach
